label: Personalised
definition: Uses this customer's own situation: industry, region, fleet, mileage, finance history, named company.

label: Concrete figures
definition: Specific numbers, calculations, savings, specifications that make the argument checkable.

label: Product knowledge
definition: Explains features, packages or services clearly and correctly.

label: Structure and readability
definition: Well organised, easy to scan, sensible order, appropriate length.

label: Appropriate register
definition: Polite, natural business Japanese; honorifics used well.

label: Persuasive framing
definition: Benefit-led, anticipates needs, builds a convincing case.

label: Honorific errors
definition: Wrong or inconsistent keigo, plain form mixed in, double honorifics, wrong referent elevated.

label: Unnatural Japanese
definition: Awkward, translated-sounding or ungrammatical Japanese, odd word choice.

label: Generic content
definition: Boilerplate that would fit any customer; claimed personalisation that is not specific.

label: Accuracy or consistency
definition: Wrong or inconsistent facts or numbers, unsupported or exaggerated claims, internal contradictions.

label: Format or language leakage
definition: Broken markup, leftover code fences, English or other non-Japanese text, labels or artefacts in the body.

label: Verbose or repetitive
definition: Too long, repeats the same point, filler.

label: Wrong tone or audience
definition: Too pushy or too casual, addresses the wrong person, reads as instructions to the rep rather than a pitch.

label: Price, cost or financing detail
definition: Missing price, quote, total cost, lease terms, payment or discount.

label: Next step
definition: Missing call to action, proposal of a meeting, test drive, timeline.

label: Objection handling
definition: A concern the customer would raise (cost, charging, reliability, change) that the script does not answer, or missing comparison with alternatives or competitors.

label: Product or evidence detail
definition: Missing specifications, proof, references, case studies, warranty or service specifics.

label: Customer data unavailable (confound)
definition: The point is that the script lacks information about THIS customer (their needs, operations, current fleet) that the script could not have had. Reflects the setup, not the script.
